scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: esbuild src/server/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --external:node:sqlite --external:ws --outfile=dist-server/main.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.dev:server: ADMIN_TOKEN=${ADMIN_TOKEN:-dev} LOG_LEVEL=${LOG_LEVEL:-debug} STATIC_DIR= PORT=3000 tsx watch src/server/main.ts
scripts.serve: npm run build && ADMIN_TOKEN=${ADMIN_TOKEN:-dev} npm start
